newsitem.title: USA: AEP Cook 1, Mich, power plant trips off.
newsitem.headline: AEP Cook 1, Mich, power plant trips off.

text.p: American Electric Power Co's 1,020 megawatt (MW) Cook 1 nuclear power station in Bridgman, Mich, tripped off line over the weekend, the Nuclear Regulatory Commission (NRC) reported Monday.
The NRC report, based on information provided by the plant's operator, said the unit would likely return to service later today.
The trip followed a sudden change of pressure in the turbine's transformer, which in turn might have been caused by a thunderstorm in the area at the time.
The unit was running at 88 percent of capacity when it shut.
